name: valmera
description: Edit uploaded video through Valmera, review a preview and export the approved MP4. Hosted editing requires a paid Valmera plan.

publication.release_notes: Initial ChatGPT and Codex package: OAuth MCP connection, guided setup, footage editing, shorts and website-demo skills. Package validation is separate from Directory approval and authenticated editing tests.

interface.longDescription: Bring your footage, describe the edit and review the result. Valmera connects your assistant to a hosted video editor for cuts, captions, framing, audio, previews and MP4 exports. Four skills help you connect, edit a recording, choose shorts from a longer video and plan a website demo. Start with a Valmera account and footage uploaded in Studio. Account creation and uploads are free; editing requires a paid Valmera plan. ChatGPT access and usage are separate. Installing the plugin does not upload footage or start an editing job.
defaultPrompt: Show my Valmera projects and help me choose a recording to edit.
Turn my selected recording into a captioned short, then show a preview.
Help me plan a clear product-demo video from my website walkthrough.
